channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Everrati’s Electric 964: The Iconic 911 Converted to Full Electric, Down to the Last Badge
item.dc:creator: Autotrader
item.description: Everrati replaced the flat-six in a 964-generation Porsche 911 with a 500-horsepower electric motor and 64 kWh battery. The RSR-tribute aero and RS 3.8 badging stay. The exhaust note doesn’t. All modifications are reversible.

item.title: Inside the Lordstown Endurance: One of Fewer Than 80 Ever Built, and One of Even Fewer Still on the Road
item.dc:creator: Aging Wheels
item.description: Lordstown Motors declared bankruptcy in 2023 after building somewhere between 56 and 80 trucks. One owner tracked down a road-legal example and has been driving it. It’s half-finished, fascinating, and may brick itself at any moment.

item.title: Costco’s $1,000 Anker Solar Kit: Capable Station, Underperforming Panel
item.dc:creator: Footprint Hero with Alex Beale
item.description: The Anker C2000X Gen 2 power station is solid at $750 standalone. The bundled 400W solar panel only pulls around 220 watts in direct noon sunlight. Third-party panels of the same rating manage over 100 watts more from the same conditions.

item.title: The Kia PV5 Is a Family Van That Finally Makes the EV Case on Pure Usefulness
item.dc:creator: Cars Uncovered
item.description: Starting at £32,995, the Kia PV5 offers five to seven seats, 1,300 litres of cargo space, 150 kW charging, and a modular Add Gear accessory system. Also available as a cargo van with no rear seats.

item.title: Pro Tips for a Full Car Wash That Actually Protects the Paint Instead of Scratching It
item.dc:creator: AMMO NYC
item.description: AMMO NYC’s Larry Kosilla walks through a complete maintenance wash covering wheels, paint, and interior with no pressure washer or lift. The drying step is where most washing-induced paint damage actually happens.

item.title: The Solar Car That Took Twenty Years to Build Is Almost Ready for Its First Customer
item.dc:creator: The Hustle
item.description: Aptera was founded in 2006, raised $42 million, lost its founders, went bankrupt, and came back. Now it is building validation vehicles in Carlsbad, California, with first customer delivery targeted for late 2026.

item.title: The Lemmo Zero Is a Flight-Ready Folding Ebike That Actually Weighs Less Than 14 Kilograms
item.dc:creator: Electroheads
item.description: The Lemmo Zero folds 20 percent smaller than a 16-inch Brompton, weighs 13.1 kg, and has a 159 Wh battery designed to clear the airline carry-on limit. It also costs less than a Brompton Electric.

item.title: Eight Failures in Four Days: Why Lucid Bought Back This $85,000 Air After Eleven Months
item.dc:creator: Engineering Explained
item.description: Eight distinct software failures over a four-day trip in a Lucid Air Touring, including a stop-mode setting that changed itself from hold to roll while the car sat parked and unoccupied. Lucid bought the car back.

item.title: The US Is Stepping Back from EVs as China Accelerates Into the Markets Nobody Else Is Watching
item.dc:creator: DW News
item.description: US EV registrations fell more than a quarter in Q1 2026 after Trump removed federal incentives. VW wrote off $500 million on a Tennessee plant. Toyota EV sales grew 79 percent. China is winning the developing world EV market.

item.title: 530 Kilometers from Tokyo on One Charge: Japan’s New Nissan Leaf Surprised Even Its Skeptics
item.dc:creator: Abroad in Japan
item.description: The new Nissan Leaf claims 528 km of range. Two people drove it north from Tokyo through Fukushima and arrived at a charger in Miyagi Prefecture with one percent battery after 530 km. A 15-minute charge restored 300 km.

item.title: Aventon’s First Full-Suspension eMTB Has Bosch-Beating Torque and a Price That Shouldn’t Exist
item.dc:creator: Evans MTB Saga
item.description: The Aventon Current is a 29-inch full-suspension trail eMTB with 120 Nm of boost torque, an 800Wh battery, and a build quality that competes with bikes costing significantly more. The reviewer went looking for the catch.

item.title: The Volvo EX60 Has 370 kW Charging, 503 Miles of Official Range, and a Cabin That Sounds Like a Concert Hall
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric CARS
item.description: The Volvo EX60 P10 first drive: 370 kW charging, 4.6-second 0-62, museum-quiet NVH, and a platform that fixes every complaint about the EX30 and EX90.

item.title: Someone Put a 4,700-Pound Hyundai Ioniq 5 XRT in SCCA Rally Cross. It Finished in the Top Half.
item.dc:creator: TheTopher
item.description: A stock Ioniq 5 XRT entered the stock AWD class at SCCA Rally Cross in Cincinnati against GR Corollas and Subaru WRXes. It finished roughly fifth or sixth out of 16. Battery draw across four full runs: 3 to 4 percent.

item.title: The Ten Longest-Range Electric Cars You Can Buy Right Now, Ranked by Real-World Miles
item.dc:creator: What Car?
item.description: Every car in the top ten manages more than 400 miles of official range. The leader hits 542. The most interesting buy on the list costs just over £43,000 and has 320 kW charging.

item.title: The Cheapest New Electric Car in America Just Tried to Cross the Country on Ionna Charging Alone
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec drove a 2027 Chevy Bolt EV from Virginia Beach to Los Angeles using only Ionna DC fast charging stations. A stress test of both the updated Bolt and the US charging network.

item.title: A Sub-$30,000 EV With Nothing to Apologize For
item.dc:creator: Auto Focus
item.description: The 2026 Chevy Bolt comes in under $30,000 with a 65 kWh battery, 262 miles of rated range, and NACS charging built in. Auto Focus spent a week driving it in New Jersey and found a car that has earned its reputation update. Nothing about it is embarrassing at its price.

item.title: Inside the Factory Making the World’s First Mass-Produced Solid-State Battery
item.dc:creator: Two Bit da Vinci
item.description: Two Bit da Vinci visited ProLogium’s headquarters in Taiwan with full production floor access. The Gen 4 cell measured 360 Wh/kg in a live test, passes China’s 2026 solid-state standard at 0.05 percent weight loss, and survived a nail, an oven at 280 degrees C, and being cut in half.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
